name: memory-curator
description: Curate file-based and optional Hindsight agent memory with source review and backend-specific verification.

interface.longDescription: Curate files offline, or use local Hindsight MCP first, then Hindsight Project Memory Cloud when local is absent. If neither MCP is present, disable Hindsight for this task and use the file workflow. Reuse hindsight-memory when available; otherwise follow the bundled workflow and actual MCP schemas. Require explicit approval for destructive changes.
defaultPrompt: Check this project's memory health and route the relevant notes.
Audit this memory library and propose safe cleanup actions.
Curate stale or conflicting memory after showing me the change list.
